acceptanceCriteria.text: Required input missing blocks artifact generation and produces manifest/HIR.
Repo root is resolved dynamically; absolute path assumptions are rejected.
Large artifact direct write is forbidden above threshold.
smart_write uses temp file, byte count, parse/schema validation, readback, and atomic rename.
smart_edit refuses missing anchors/ranges and validates temp copy before final replace.
JSON/YAML outputs must parse successfully before success is reported.
Schema validation runs when schema is available; failure blocks final artifact success.
Truncation detection prevents success and forbids retrying with the same write method.
Multi-artifact tasks are decomposed into staged generation.
If schema additionalProperties=false, extra design fields go to companion artifacts, not the schema-bound artifact.
The system does not continue after required input, write, parse, or schema failure unless routed to explicit repair/HIR.
No generic research-worker framework is introduced.

mustNotBuild: Generic common research-worker system with plugin architecture
Long-running artifact repair daemon with polling
Full AST editor with every-language parser integration
Over-broad refactor engine with dependency analysis

mustNotReuse: No creation of alternative atomic-write, parser-validation, or path-guard implementations
